The Personal Banking & Commercial Banking Data Strategy team is looking for a passionate and innovative Senior Data Scientist within our data asset team. As a Data Scientist you will train, analyze, design, implement and monitor machine learning models and applications using state of the art tools and algorithms. You will collaborate with a highly talented team of data engineers, data scientists, data architects, and data analysts to deliver business value to the organization. You will develop recommendations for new ways to improve data quality throughout the data transformation lifecycle.

• Design, build, validate, deploy, and analyze advanced models using machine learning, AI, and statistics end-to end, including feature engineering, model training, model inference, model production, model monitoring and model maintenance.
• Work with big data, and cloud technologies such as Spark, Hadoop, and AWS environment (SageMaker, S3, Redshift)
• Join data across multiple data environments, such as HDFS, S3 and Data Warehouses, using SQL queries with complex joins, groupings, and aggregations.
• Partner with RBC internal partners and lines of businesses (Digital Marketing, Programmatic Media) to help them frame use cases and define success metrics (Key Performance Indicators).
• Document and Validate model design and performance to ensure quality and scalability of all models.
• Monitor model performance and business success metrics over time.
• Be responsible for researching new capabilities and technologies to drive innovation.
• Work closely with development teams to learn about needs, current processes and to promote best practices.
• Master\'s degree in Statistics, Economics, Marketing (Quantitative Workstream) Mathematics, or related quantitative field
• 3+ years of hands-on experience or similar post-grad work in applying Machine Learning to Customer Marketing

• Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and machine learning (including deep learning), especially in areas like: Causal inference, regression analysis, hypothesis testing, Bayesian inference, time series forecasting, propensity modelling, attrition modelling, attribution, segmentation, CLV, and behavioural analytics.
• Professional software development experience with Spark, Hadoop, AWS Cloud (SageMaker, S3, Redshift), GitHub and SQL
• Strong programming skills in python (preferred), including relevant statistical, machine learning, and deep learning libraries (pandas, numpy, stats models, scikit-learn, tensorflow/pytorch, etc.)
• Able to clearly convey technical concepts and results to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
• Experience in running A/B testing experiments in production. Experience with relational databases. Domain specific knowledge of marketing campaigns.
• Experience in financial services industry with broad understanding of marketing, product management, sales, finance, pricing and risk management is preferred.
• Publications in machine learning and artificial intelligence.
• Passion for ethical AI and experience in algorithm transparency and interpretability.

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.
• A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable.
• Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
• Ability to make a difference and lasting impact.
• Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team.
• A world-class training program in financial services
• Opportunities to do challenging work, to take on progressively greater accountabilities and to building close relationships with clients.
• Access to a variety of job opportunities across business and geographies.

The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) is the engine for reinvention in our clients’ transformation journey. Powered by more than 255,000 people across 24 countries, ATCs will provide our clients seamless access to industry insights and innovative technology solutions.

The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) make tremendous impact in solving our clients’ business problems leveraging Innovation, Intelligence, Industry insights, new IT and new technology skills. Now, with the global environment changing at a faster pace, our clients are facing unprecedented challenges, and they need us more than ever before. As a Network, ATCs are positioned to unlock greater opportunities and exponential value for our clients.
The value for our clients and our people

For our clients, the Network provides the strength of our geographic diversity, greater resilience, and seamless access to the deepest industry knowledge, the latest in Gen AI solutions, and tech expertise from around the world.

For our people, it brings an opportunity to shape truly boundaryless career paths in a highly collaborative team of experts where they can learn from each other and solve the world’s most complex client challenges.

• As an AI and Large Language model Architect, you will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing the technology architecture for advanced AI (including Large Language Model (LLM)) platform systems and solutions.

• Translate business roadmap into technical requirements and architecture. Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping cutting-edge architectures, frameworks, and methodologies, pushing the boundaries of natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning.

• Architect sophisticated large language models (LLMs) with the remarkable ability to process and generate natural language. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to design neural network parameters, leveraging extensive amounts of unlabeled text data, to further enhance the model\'s capabilities.
• Estimate cost of using LLMs in different forms for business use cases and the viability, develop cost models for different usage patterns
• Architect components of an LLM solution to address Responsible AI & Security
• Design and prototype reusable components for LLM based solution patterns
• Design LLM Ops solutions for large scale operationalization
show more show less
• 2+ years of experience designing end to end Generative AI products, applications and solutions for specific business needs and provide implementation guidance during delivery.
• 2+ years’ experience leveraging, customizing and implementing Gen AI models, algorithms, and methodologies to improve the overall quality Gen AI products, applications and systems.
• 2+ years’ experience interacting with stakeholders, understanding business requirements and coming up with a technical blueprint based on client needs

• 2+ years’ experience creating and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation that comprehensibly captures the intricate details of the language model, facilitating seamless understanding, efficient troubleshooting, and future development.
• 1+ year of experience analyzing and evaluating the performance of Gen AI systems and provide design recommendations.
• 2+ years’ experience managing teams on an onsite/offshore model.
• This role is based in our Local ATCs (Montreal) and will require on-site 2-3 days per week.

• English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with stakeholders across Canada, US and other countries across our Global footprint where English is the common language. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English-speaking stakeholders, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company\'s activities to avoid this requirement.

• Currently enrolled in a PhD degree in Computer Science, Linguistics, Statistics, Biostatistics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, Natural Sciences, or related technical field.

• Experience in one area of computer science (e.g., Natural Language Understanding, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Quantum Information Science, Data Science, Software Developing, or similar areas).
• Currently attending a degree program in Canada and available to work full time for a minimum of 12 weeks outside of university term time.
• In their penultimate academic year or returning to a degree program after completion of the internship.
• Experience as a researcher, including internships, full-time, or at a lab.
• Experience contributing research communities or efforts, including publishing papers in major conferences or journals.
• Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, C/C++, etc.).

Join us for a full-time, 12-14 week paid internship that offers personal and professional development, an executive speaker series, and community-building. Research happens across Google everyday, in many different teams. Our research has already impacted user-facing services across Google, including Search, Maps, and Google Now, and is central to the success of Google Cloud and our planet-scale computing, storage, and networking infrastructure.

Research Interns work closely with Developers to discover, invent, and build at the largest scale. Ideas may come from internal projects. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing architectures, Research Interns work on challenges in artificial intelligence, machine perception, data mining, machine learning, natural language understanding, privacy, computer architecture, networking, operating systems, storage and data management, and more.

Google Research addresses challenges that define the technology of today and tomorrow. From conducting fundamental research to influencing product development, our research teams have the opportunity to impact technology used by billions of people every day.

Our teams aspire to make discoveries that impact everyone, and core to our approach is sharing our research and tools to fuel progress in the field -- we publish regularly in academic journals, release projects as open source, and apply research to Google products.

Data Science Integration Architect- Health Care and Life Sciences

The people who love using data to tell a story. We’re also the world’s largest team of integration architects, healthcare standards experts, data scientists, data engineers, and experts in machine learning and AI. A great day for us? Solving big problems using the latest tech, serious brain power, and deep knowledge of just about every industry. We believe a mix of architecture, data, analytics, automation, and responsible AI can do almost anything—spark digital metamorphoses, widen the range of what humans can do, and breathe life into smart products and services. Want to join our crew of sharp analytical minds? Visit us here to find out more about Applied Intelligence.

An experienced professional solving real-world challenges with architecture, data exchange standards, FHIR servers, cloud platforms and creativity within the healthcare and/or life sciences industry. • Experience implementing a FHIR server (HAPI, Smile CDR, etc.)
• Experience architecting interoperable solutions on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, etc.)
• Experience with other data exchange standards and frameworks (e.g., HL7 v2, CDA, IHE, etc.)
• Minimum 2.5 years of experience as part of interoperable solutions design and deployment teams in healthcare or life sciences

• Technical skills in more than one of Python, Java, FHIR, JSON
• Minimum undergraduate degree from a recognized university in an applicable field such as Bachelor of Science, Computer Science or Health Informatics

This is an opportunity within the Data & Analytics team at RBC Global Asset Management. We are seeking a hands-on, highly skilled, and motivated individual to join our dynamic team as a Senior Data Platform Engineer. As a key member of our data engineering team, you will play a crucial role in the development and implementation of GAM’s Data Platform. Your primary focus will be on designing, implementing, and maintaining robust data infrastructure to support our organization’s data needs and advance our capabilities pertaining to data engineering, BI, Machine Learning and AI.
• Work closely with Data Engineering and Analytics team to drive business decisions using data.
• Build scalable data platform infrastructure using cloud native technologies to enable Data Engineering, Data Science and Reporting.
• Take ownership of end-to-end deliverables and ensure high quality data solutions adhering to data platform architecture guidelines and engineering best practices.
• Enable the deployment of batch and event-driven data pipelines using latest technologies such as Spark, NiFi, Kafka, and Airflow.
• Configure and manage scalable and managed SQL based self-serve compute platform using Starburst Trino.
• Implement data management tools to streamline data processing, testing, preparing, deploying, and monitoring.
• Improve the speed and quality of the data development process by applying DevOps principles to data workflow.
• Ensure data security standards are applied across the data pipelines.
• Troubleshoot and resolve data integration and data processing issues.
• Perform proof-of-concepts to implement hybrid cloud data strategy involving on-prem systems like S3, OpenShift, Trino, Spark with Cloud based solutions like Databricks, Azure, Snowflake, etc.

About the job

Join us for a full-time, 12-14 week paid internship that offers personal and professional development, an executive speaker series, and community-building. Research happens across Google everyday, in many different teams. Our research has already impacted user-facing services across Google, including Search, Maps, and Google Now, and is central to the success of Google Cloud and our planet-scale computing, storage, and networking infrastructure.

Research Interns aren\'t cloistered in the lab, but instead they work closely with Engineers to discover, invent, and build at the largest scale. Ideas may come from internal projects. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, Research Interns work on challenges in artificial intelligence, machine perception, data mining, machine learning, natural language understanding, privacy, computer architecture, networking, operating systems, storage and data management, and much more.

Google Research addresses challenges that define the technology of today and tomorrow. From conducting fundamental research to influencing product development, our research teams have the opportunity to impact technology used by billions of people every day.

column3: >Are you an early career researcher with the potential to become a world-class machine learning scientist? The Vector Institute invites applications for Postdoctoral Fellows who are working on cutting-edge fundamental research in machine learning and deep learning algorithms and their applications.

>The standard term for a Postdoctoral Fellow position is 1–2 years, with a possible extension to 3 years. Also available is the opportunity for eligible individuals to complete a placement at Vector before going on to take a faculty role elsewhere.

>Postdoctoral Fellows at the Vector Institute are early career researchers with the potential to become world-class researchers. Like postdoctoral researchers in a university lab, Postdoctoral Fellows at the Vector Institute are tasked with and supported in carrying out state-of-the-art research, publishing at the highest international level, and contributing to the academic life and reputation of the Institute. The Vector Institute offers a dynamic environment, and research freedom and opportunity to collaborate within and across research areas. They are part of a thriving research community of over 500 Vector Faculty Members, Faculty Affiliates, Postgraduate Affiliates, Postdoctoral Fellows, and graduate students.

>Postdoctoral Fellows at the Vector Institute have access to the resources of a well-funded institute dedicated solely to machine learning and deep learning, and are encouraged to work with any of our over 30 world-class faculty in machine learning and deep learning, though they will work primarily with 1–2 faculty members.

>They will be expected to propose work on research topics of their interest related to machine learning and deep learning and carry out that research with a great deal of independence. Should they be so inclined, Postdoctoral Fellows may teach and mentor at the Institute
column5: and/or work with existing companies to enhance their research. They have the ability to collaborate with the graduate students of the machine learning group at the University of Toronto, as well as the graduate students of other affiliated faculty, who spend the bulk of their time at the Institute.

column3: >The Vector Institute is an independent non-profit corporation, with Faculty Members and Affiliates from the University of Toronto, University of Waterloo, and other Canadian universities. It is supported with generous funding from the provincial and federal governments, as well as Canadian industry sponsors.

>The Vector Institute is located in the MaRS Discovery District building, spanning nearly the entire 7th floor and overlooking downtown Toronto and the beautiful Queen’s Park. On any given day, the Vector Institute houses over a hundred students, dozens of Faculty Members, supported with state-of-the-art compute power, and dedicated professional staff. The daily life and concentration of expertise in the Institute fosters collaboration and the exchange of ideas among its members through talks, seminar series, visitors, and tutorials.

>The Vector Institute’s vision is to drive excellence in the creation of artificial intelligence, to use it to foster economic growth, and to improve the lives of Canadians. To that end, the Vector Institute has close ties to both academia and industry. This puts our Postdoctoral Fellows in a unique position to contribute broadly. A successful contribution can range from developing core algorithmic techniques and theoretical analyses of machine learning algorithms, to working closely with existing companies and health organization, to engaging in entrepreneurial activities.

>In addition to their research, Postdoctoral Fellows have the opportunity to work with industry to develop machine-learning-based solutions for their problems or engage in related entrepreneurial activities. We have dedicated staff facilitating all aspects of engaging with Vector sponsors and affiliated institutions, as well as close ties to incubators for entrepreneurial activities. The Vector Institute has extensive access to computing resources and datasets. We have a team of AI Engineers who help improve research productivity through software platform development, ensuring research reproducibility, publishing open source code and data, and in readying code for commercial use.

>We are looking for people with interests across a broad spectrum from core machine learning or deep learning research to more applied and entrepreneurial activities. We are also looking for people who have excelled in other areas and are interested in moving into deep learning or machine learning more broadly.

We’re a small, diverse team working at the cutting edge of machine learning. At Cohere, our mission is to build machines that understand the world and to make them safely accessible to all. Language is at the crux of this, but it can be difficult and expensive to parse the syntax, semantics, and context that all work together to give words meaning. The Cohere platform provides access to Large Language Models through its APIs that read billions of web pages and learn to understand the meaning, sentiment, and intent of the words we use in a richness never seen before.

We recently raised our Series B, signed a multi-year partnership with Google Cloud, and we are focused on bringing our technology to market. We will partner with customers so they can build natural language understanding and generation into their products with just a few lines of code.

We’re ambitious — we believe our technology will fundamentally transform how industries interact with natural language. Title: Senior Data Scientist

Digital & Operational Excellence (PTE) is a new organization within Roche that will catalyze the development of Roche’s manufacturing digital strategy to work towards a factory of the future. We will build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, and further develop the Lean and Digital skills across Pharma Technical Operation (PT), and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients.

We aim to activate data citizenship and digital mindset, revolutionize our FAIR data ecosystem and systems landscape, re-design excellent processes, and generate transformative insights. We collaborate closely with global functions to deliver impactful value to our patients.

Data Scientists play a key role in transforming vast amounts of structured and unstructured data into insights, building predictive analytics and machine learning (ML) models for complex business problems that enable the organization in data-driven decision making. You work as an innovator, inventor, investigator, partner, engineer, “firefighter'' and, of course, as a scientist. You drive the implementation of new business solutions and challenge the status quo. You assist in the planning, execution and delivering of advanced analytics based projects with the majority of the work spent analyzing problems, exploring datasets, developing and operationalizing statistical and machine learning models. You will be key to actively build new Data Products published in our Data Mesh and work closely with Subject matter experts within the manufacturing, quality and development organizations of PT to deliver fit-for-purpose-analytics.
• Be part of a cross-functional use case team to address high-pressing business problems and become familiar with our product-related data, manufacturing processes and systems
• Undertake appropriate preprocessing of structured and unstructured data with additional support of Data Engineers and evolve and build new Data Products (Data Mesh)
• Analyze small to medium amounts of static and real-time data to discover trends and patterns, and to implement analysis pipelines
• Build predictive models and machine-learning algorithms to predict manufacturing related issues of the products
• You have a Master’s Degree with minimum of 6 years of relevant work experience, or PhD degree in Software Engineering, Data Science, Bioinformatics or a related field.

• Advanced knowledge of programming languages (Python, R) and ability to implement pipelines. In-depth knowledge of various types of machine learning algorithms and ability to design, apply and evaluate multiple/ensemble ML models for a given problem and choosing the best fit design.
• Proficiency in developing ETL data pipelines and using cloud computing to run pipelines and ML models (GCP/AWS, Apache airflow)
• Extensive knowledge of ML frameworks (tensorflow, Pythorch, Spark ML), data structures, modeling, and software architecture.
• In-depth knowledge of applying unsupervised and supervised models and ability to identify linear and non-linear (latent-variable models) relationships in data.

• Able to extract data to design the appropriate analytical models and translate data into insights. Able to create/process/interpret data visualizations. Able to use data and analytics to significantly increase value and reach better outcomes as well as using data analysis to identify opportunities for increased data quality. Ability to analyze Big Data & Business Intelligence.
• Applies elements of the FAIR Data Citizenship (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) as baseline for all decision making processes.
• Solid knowledge of Pharma Industry, GMP and CSV regulations.

• Able to demonstrate an enterprise mindset and entrepreneurial behaviors broadly across different work scenarios. Identify user needs and generate viable solutions in a creative process using innovation frameworks and tools (e.g. DesignThinking, Sprints, User Stories/Personas etc).
• Ability to communicate a compelling story and complex concepts with aspirational language that data professionals, business stakeholders and decision makers equally understand.
• Understand and be able to explain the concept of agility, agile ways of working/thinking, key principles, values and purpose, as well as the OneRoche. Agile terminology.
This position is not eligible for relocation support.

Quantitative Risk is part of CIBC’s Capital Market Risk Management (CMRM), which is led by the Executive Vice President and Chief Risk Officer. CMRM is accountable for the identification, management, and control of the risks taken by CIBC Capital Markets. Quantitative Risk is responsible for providing continuous enhancements, controls, and the monitoring of all models used for risk measurements of Capital Market products, including compliance with current and new regulatory regimes.

As the Senior Quantitative Analyst, Risk Model Performance & Analytics, you will be responsible for CIBC’s Initial Margin Model and monitoring of the adequacy of the model as well as the accurate risk capture of Initial Margin under ISDA SIMM v2.5. You will have frequent interaction with CIBC and client’s collateral teams through this process. You will be responsible for ongoing enhancement of the model as new versions are released.

Additionally, you will be responsible for creating and streamlining analysis and reporting processes through automation and creation of tools for more effective and proactive risk management. You will work closely with our colleagues within Risk and our Technology partners.
You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

• Problem Solving and Communication – Ensure effective identification of issues impacting Capital Market Risk Management models performance, timely communication and escalation of identified issues to relevant stakeholder groups and senior management, and adequate prioritization for resolving identified issues.

• Automation and Creative Solutioning – Using development best practices, you will be expected to identify opportunities to automate workflow and processes. Utilize your understanding of financial modelling to automate and further develop creative solutions. Create and enhance documentation pertaining to model governance and controls.

• Domain Knowledge – Demonstrate in-depth understanding of valuation & risk models. Demonstrate and continue to grow knowledge of trading and hedging strategies, Capital Markets products, and regulatory changes pertaining to market risk capital and Initial Margin requirements. Remain abreast of market environment, news and events, and be proactive in assessing their potential impact on model performance. Develop expertise in CMRM and Capital Markets systems, processes and underlying models.

• Relationship Building – Develop and maintain excellent relationships with various groups across Capital Markets Risk Management, Capital Markets, Technology and Finance as most of the issues identified through model performance monitoring require collaborative effort among multiple teams to resolve. Establish and maintain clear and concise lines of communication and foster a collaborative culture while keeping in mind that this role is part of Capital Markets Risk Management and is thus a 2nd line of defense with the accountability of providing effective challenge, monitoring, and oversight.

• You\'re digitally savvy. You have solid technical skills ( e.g. Python, R, C++, etc.) and you seek out innovative solutions and embrace evolving technologies. You can easily adapt to new tools, systems and trends.
• You give meaning to data. You enjoy investigating complex problems, and making sense of information. You\'re confident in your ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way.

STATEMENT OF WORK: FastLane - Data Readiness & Model Deployment - Instructor

These Instructor positions are for the development and delivery of the Data Readiness & Model Deployment program. This program is being held for employees of companies within the Vector Institute’s FastLane ecosystem.

The program consists of two modules: 1) Data Readiness and Model Development and 2) Model Deployment. The instructor(s) will be responsible for developing and delivering lecture content and performing hands-on demos for either one or both modules. In your application, please indicate which module(s) you are applying for. The teaching commitment will vary from three to eight weeks depending on the module(s) for which you apply. Each lecture will be 2 hours in duration.
Fees: This is a paid position. The flat fee for development and delivery of content is $5,000 (CAD) for Module 1 and $3000 (CAD) for Module 2.
Module 1: Data Readiness and Model Development – 5 Weeks
* Dates shifted due to Civic Holiday

• Ensure that all course materials (e.g. lesson objectives, slides, discussion prompts, assignment activities) are prepared in advance of the lecture time and are available in the Vector Learning Management System (LMS), currently D2L
• Attend scheduled program team meetings: planning and debrief (typically weekly)
• Partake in a Vector training workshop/briefing with Vector staff
• Teach all lectures in the program on time, to a high standard of service, and in an environment free of distractions
• Attend the capstone presentations (or any makeup sessions) for the purposes of evaluating capstones, and offering feedback to presenters

• Manage participants' learning progress: work closely with Technical Advisors (TAs) and the Vector Professional Development (PD) staff to ensure the program is delivered successfully and participants’ issues are dealt with in a professional manner. The Instructor and TAs will interact directly with participants on the content itself. Vector staff will grant extensions and notices of completion, and all other issues considered ""customer service"".
The instructor, in communication with Vector Professional Development staff, will develop and deliver content in line with the following:

The rise of machine learning has rapidly changed the way companies do business. Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) that adopt machine learning algorithms gain a competitive edge in their respective markets, can make better business decisions, and work more efficiently. Many SMEs may not have the expertise or resources to implement machine learning effectively. To address this issue, the Vector Institute is piloting a new training program that will equip SMEs with the skills and knowledge necessary to accelerate the implementation of machine learning on a pre-defined use case within their organizations.
This training program consists of two modules:
Many companies face the challenge of having sparse or low-quality data or may inadvertently work with incorrect data transformations, which can all affect the accuracy of machine learning models.

The Data Readiness portion addresses these issues by providing companies with an understanding of identifying relevant data sources and data cleaning and preprocessing techniques for their specific data types. Companies will also learn how to visualize and explore their data to identify relevant patterns and relationships. Lastly, this portion will introduce strategies for mitigating data bias and include discussions on data governance.

The Model Development portion will provide companies with the awareness to select the appropriate machine learning algorithm(s) for their use case, evaluate their models, and optimize performance. Since companies will be working on different data types, they will have access to reference implementations of various models created by the Vector Institute and work following a self-guided approach. Active class time will focus on common topics, reflection and discussion. This portion will also introduce principles and practices for building trustworthy AI systems.

In the Model Deployment module, SMEs will learn about strategies to deploy their machine learning models and integrate them into their business practices. SMEs will also learn about the MLOps ecosystem, how to monitor and maintain their deployed model and ensure its continued performance.

The program is designed to cover the entire lifecycle of a machine learning project. Each module will be conducted over a period of three to five weeks and SMEs will be assigned a Technical Advisor (TA) to provide guidance and support throughout the program. TAs will be experienced machine learning practitioners who will provide feedback on the SMEs’ work and help address any roadblocks that may arise during the program.

At the end of the program, SMEs will have three weeks of dedicated time to focus on their use case, in consultation with their TA. The program culminates in a 10-minute capstone presentation where companies will have an opportunity to showcase their work and receive feedback from their peers and members of the Vector community.

Program sessions will be delivered in an interactive lecture/discussion format, with practical examples and case studies used to spark reflection and discussion. Sessions are designed to leverage learners’ prior experience, stimulate conversation, and move each company towards a viable Proof of Concept (PoC) by the end of the program. All sessions will be delivered online.

Hands-on examples will involve Python and will be provided in the form of Jupyter notebooks. (.ipynb files). Notebooks can be executed within a web browser using Google Colab or locally on a learner’s personal computer. Learners should be familiar with navigating the notebook environment, writing and executing Python code, and styling text using Markdown. Some external resources on these topics will also be provided prior to the start of the training program.

The program will expose learners to several open-source Python packages. Coding concepts will be delivered at an intermediate level and each company should have at least one technical participant who is familiar with the following packages:
• numpy and pandas for manipulating arrays and dataframes
• matplotlib or similar visualization or exploratory data analysis packages
• scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch: popular machine learning frameworks

To apply, please submit your CV and cover letter to learn@vectorinstitute.ai.

In your application, please indicate which module(s) you are applying for.
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until filled.

Come Work with Us!

At RBC, our culture is deeply supportive and rich in opportunity and reward. You will help our clients thrive and our communities prosper, empowered by a spirit of shared purpose.

Whether you’re helping clients find new opportunities, developing new technology, or providing expert advice to internal partners, you will be doing work that matters in the world, in an environment built on teamwork, service, responsibility, diversity, and integrity.

Job Title

2023 GRM, Fall Global Risk Analytics (4 Months)

Global Risk Analytics (GRA) is the center of expertise for models used in risk management. This includes risk analytics for market risk, counterparty credit risk and emerging risk. GRA’s analytics innovation team focuses on emerging risks, including machine learning and climate analytics.

Given the large size of market data, data analytics (e.g., using advanced techniques such as machine learning) are needed to provide business insights. In addition, having an intelligent data visualization platform would bring the analytical presentation to the next level. As a result, GRA is developing a Dashboard web application for this purpose. This web application would serve as a centralized platform to host various data analytics dashboards.

Further, due to increasing importance of assessing the impacts of climate change to financial institutions, GRA is also building expertise in climate risk analytics to support RBC’s various climate risk stress testing and scenario analysis mandates (e.g., CCAR in US, ICAAP in UK). In particular, GRA has the model development ownership for several regional climate risk scenario analysis models, covering both transition risk (posed to clients in transition to low-carbon economy) and physical risk (posed by acute weather events) for different asset classes (e.g., corporate bond, municipal bonds, real estate, and wholesale loans).

Climate analytics is an emerging field. Institutions around the world (e.g., regulators, banks, vendors, etc.) are grappling with the challenges in how to enhance the data, scenario design, and methodology. At this stage, GRA is currently developing a unified platform to onboard different “climate risk + machine learning” modules, and potentially utilizing open-source data (if deemed appropriate) for research purposes.

GRA is seeking an individual who is interested in applying data analytics (including machine learning) and programming skills to empower our climate risk analytics capability. The intern student will be involved in researching open-source data platforms for climate risk, and developing Python-based tools for climate risk related analytics and machine learning applications. The candidate will learn data analytics and machine learning with applications in climate risk.
• Assist to research open-source data and analytics platforms, such as OS-Climate, Oasis, Climate Analytics CIE, WRI Aqueduct, World Bank CCKP.
• Identify use cases of the open-source platforms.
• Assist to design and implement Python-based tools for climate risk related applications.
• Make presentation to senior people in risk
• Strong programming experience in Python and SQL.
• Knowledge about machine learning, data analytics, and data visualization
• Ability to communicate technical matters in written and oral forms
• Interest in learning about emerging data and techniques to assess climate risk impact.
• Understand of the big picture regarding how risk function works in banks
• Knowledge of financial products in trading book and banking book.

Sun Life Retail Advice & Solutions (RA&S) is one of the leading financial institutions that offer Canadians holistic advice and innovative solutions including insurance, wealth and health through a team of digitally-enabled and insights-driven human advisors.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President Strategy & Enablement, AVP- Advanced Analytics & Business Intelligence (BI) will be responsible for the developing and implementing data analytics strategy to enable RA&S in achieving sustainable competitive advantage, growth and profitability. The successful candidate will work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment with a focus on leading advanced analytics initiatives and business intelligence to enable RA&S to stay in the forefront of competitor actions and market developments.
• Develop data analytics strategy that enables business medium-term strategy to create sustainable growth
• Implement data analytics strategy by adapting and / or transforming existing data engineering, business intelligence, and advanced analytics functions
• Partner with CXO Data Analytics team to align with overall Canada data analytics strategy.
• Maintain existing data foundation for business intelligence, and self serve and advanced analytics
• Adapt data foundation as needed to meet analytics and business intelligence needs while ensuring it is continuously operational with minimal disruption
• Lead transformation initiative to migrate data foundation to a modern cloud-based environment
• Identify and review strategic issues facing the business and provide analysis, decision support, and develop implementation ready strategies and tactics
• Drive thought leadership in solving strategic issues using data driven approaches using data analytics
• Run business intelligence function that supports decision making and performance management
• Manage and prioritize request in-take from various stakeholders that optimize delivery across factors such as value, time-to-market, and effort
• Lead efforts to democratize data analytics by creating self serve capabilities for power users to access data, conduct analysis and generate insights
• Ensure business intelligence function delivers value to business stakeholders, e.g. turn complex data into easy-to-understand insights with optimized visualizations
• Proactively apply data science and advanced analytics techniques to identify and address business opportunities
• Lead execution of data science projects and manage coordination of project delivery across functions
• Operationalize analytical models in the field by addressing technology, process and change management requirements
• Collaborate with data analytics partners in Canada and ES to leverage common capabilities, tools and assets
• Implement consistent and comprehensive standards in documentation across data engineering, business intelligence and analytical models
• Maintain documentation of existing data processes and models
• Ensure knowledge are cross pollinated across the team to minimize key personnel knowledge risk
• Ensure data and analytical processes adhere to compliance processes and data privacy policies, e.g. MEUC, PIA
• Effectively communicate key insights, ideas and strategies, to an executive level audience in a clear, compelling and concise manner
• Proactively stay in touch with internal partners to maintain an understanding of new developments in their areas
• Tailor both written and verbal communication based on audience and situation to maximize buy-in and establish productive working relationships
• Lead and coach a diverse reporting team through proactive career development and continuous feedback loop
• Actively promote Sun Life brand and community image to attract talent and external partners
• Ensure ongoing compliance with all applicable regulatory and policy requirements
• Minimum of 10 years relevant business experience, ideally within insurance, wealth management or other financial services
• Experience in leading advanced data analytics functions, e.g. predictive analytics, business intelligence, data engineering
• Strong business and technical understanding of data and advanced analytics concepts and technology
• Experience in leading high performing teams and professional knowledge workers
• Experience in financial and quantitative analysis, including using modelling tools and techniques, would be an asset
• University degree in business, engineering, computer science or related discipline
• Competitive salary and bonus structure influenced by market range data
• 20 days vacation per year and an innovative sabbatical program
• Great Place to Work® Certified in Canada and the US - 2022
• Great Place to Work® award for Best Workplaces for #HybridWork - 2022
• Flex hours and Flexible hybrid work model including in-country work-from-home if you prefer.
• Being part of our Analytics community, where we share best practices and broaden skill-sets

Tell us your story. Don’t go unnoticed. Explain why you’re a winning candidate. Think “TD” if you crave meaningful work and embrace change like we do. We are a trusted North American leader that cares about people and inspires them to grow and move forward.
Stay current and competitive. Carve out a career for yourself. Grow with us. Here’s our story: jobs.td.com

We can’t afford to be boring. Neither can you. The scale and scope of what TD does may surprise you. The rapid pace of change makes it a business imperative for us to be smart and open-minded in the way we think about strategy. TD’s strategy and business teams become more intertwined as new opportunities present themselves. This new era in banking does not equal boring. Not at TD, Not at Risk, Not at Fraud strategy, anyway.

The Enterprise Protect is an enterprise-level body that strives to protect TD Bank Group customers, shareholders and employees from financial crimes and fraud. Aligned with TD strategy and risk appetite, Enterprise Protect develops and evolves enterprise policies, advanced analytics capabilities and operational processes to improve governance, oversight, and collaboration between fraud management and other control functions within the Bank.

The Canadian Performance Management (CPM) team operates within Enterprise Protect in a fast-paced environment requiring both strategic and tactical responses to changing fraud patterns and provides a unique opportunity to apply critical thinking and leadership skills in an innovation centric environment.

This role will be responsible for developing, implementing and monitoring strategies to manage evolving fraud trends, taking into consideration TD’s risk appetite and customer and operational experience. The Strategist should display a deep fraud and process expertise, and to leverage that knowledge to:
• anticipate and explain potential fraud risks associated with strategic initiatives across TD
• help design policy, process or strategic changes to enable the bank to safely deliver its strategic roadmap
• provide deep fraud and process expertise into solving larger, Fraud-driven strategic initiatives
• identify emerging fraud trends and develop defenses against emerging and in-market fraud trends
• understand and actively managing the operational impacts of our fraud defense strategies

The successful candidate will work collaboratively with a diverse team of operational agents, Fraud solution developers, data scientists, business insights analysts and subject matter experts and applies fraud business expertise leveraging advanced tools and detection systems to manage risk appropriately. The incumbent will be accountable for loss and customer experience targets.
• Accountable for fraud loss targets and the customer experience
• Reviews daily fraud attacks to create segmentation and develop/implement fraud strategies while balancing the impact to the operational teams and customer experience
• Strategizes on adjustments to shifting network rules, liability requirements or other exogenous factors

• Owns the strategy design and configuration in all fraud prevention platforms (e.g. Falcon, TSYS, FIS, SQN, PRM, Citadel, DPS, VCas, Avant, Experian, Transunion), in alignment with the Change Management protocols
• Supports case valuation and prioritization to optimize fraud management
• Are a subject matter expert on the end-to-end operational process, transaction liability and regulatory requirements
• Provide ad-hoc analysis to support decision-making at the executive level
• Design champion / challenger strategies that lead to ongoing learning and improvement
• Expected to leverage that subject matter expertise to independently investigate new, high-risk exposures under very tight timelines
• Produce timely diagnostics to identify system, strategy and operational issues
• Participates in defect analysis to identify and remediate coverage gaps
• Provides end to end fraud cycle support to all strategy teams for advanced technical builds and consultation for continuous improvement
• Identify, track, and provide solutions to ongoing fraud vectors and cross-portfolio threats
• Think forward and provide early gap mitigation to emerging threat vectors globally
• Works with business partners to understand new intent, and to identify the incremental fraud risks associated with that intent
• Collaborates with business partners to develop solutions that minimize fraud risk while enabling business partners to achieve bank strategic priorities
• Occasionally provides IT release support to ensure projects reliably deliver on fraud requirements
• Support the continuous improvement agenda for our operational partners
• Maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders such as Fraud Operations, Internal Business Partners, Vendor Managers etc.
• Act as a subject matter expert and represents the team or bank at project meetings or industry forums
• Undergraduate degree from a technical domain (e.g. finance, engineering, mathematics/statistics computer science), preferably from a STEM program
• 2+ years’ experience in an analytical capacity
• Experience using analytical software tools such as Python, R, SQL, Tableau and Excel for data analysis, automation, and reporting
• In-depth knowledge of data science tools such as NumPy, pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn/TensorFlow/Keras or equivalent
• Understanding of machine learning methods with experience in deployment and implementation
• Experience with automation tools and proven implementation record
• Ability to quickly and independently structure and deliver on new problems not previous tackled by the bank
• Demonstrated analytical, modeling and problem solving skills
• Creative, Critical, Conceptual thinker, ability to wade through data and arrive at conclusions
• Ability to communicate strategy analysis to both technical and non-technical team members, either verbally or via documentation
• Ability to take initiative and work independently under tight timelines
• Ability to work collaboratively and build relationships
• Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
• Motivated to constantly strive to find innovative ways to enhance capabilities
• Experience in fraud management is an asset
• Knowledge of machine learning is an asset
• Knowledge of fraud detection platforms is an asset

The Data Strategy & Enablement team is on a continuous journey towards helping TELUS become a world-class leader in data solutions. We are doing so by delivering data analytics capabilities built upon unified scalable platforms, advanced AI tooling and high quality data. We have a data-product and data platform oriented culture and we are always keeping an eye on the horizon, preparing for the next big thing.

We are entrepreneurial and passionate, believers that so much more is possible and can be achieved by creating value and great outcomes for our customers, team members, communities, and environment and that through meaningful transformation we can integrate dynamic change in our professional lives.
Our team members appreciate diversity of thinking, ideas and experiences, and are always learning, experimenting and applying tuition value into everything we do.
The impact you’ll make and what we’ll accomplish together

As an API & Data Management Developer in the Metadata Management Program, you’ll contribute to the design, development and support of a variety of integration and process automation techniques to ensure accurate ingestion of technical metadata from many source systems. You will design and develop APIs to enable programmatic consumption of metadata by consumers external to the metadata management platform. In addition you will ensure reliable and consistent processing to our Collibra cloud platform and automate information lifecycle management processes using web enabled workflows.

As a trusted technical expert, you will collaborate with various business units and demonstrate thought leadership when sitting at the intersection between privacy, ethics, technology, data and consumers to ensure it is leveraged in a respectful manner while continuing to advance our reputation of being trustworthy through transparent communication.
• Work with business stakeholders on the adoption and onboarding of the TELUS Metadata Management Tool powered by Collibra (training and technical support)

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to define integration approaches, identify the best techniques, ensure capture and storage of all available metadata, ensure durable API processing is available to subscription customers
• Support and maintain the API enablement of the TELUS Metadata Management Tool powered by Collibra through the entire lifecycle from design to deployment within the TELUS cloud environment
• Work with the supporting teams, organizations and vendors to provide updates to existing deployed technologies and collect information from production systems for analysis
• Define, enable, test and automate scripts for integration and process automation activities including documentation, work products and team presentations as well
• Develop test strategies and site reliability engineering measures for data products and solutions
• Participate in agile development scrums and solutions reviews
• Lead resolution of critical operations issues including post-implementation reviews
• Contribute to the strategic direction and evolution of TELUS Enterprise Metadata & Data Quality Management application
You are the missing piece of the puzzle
• You are sought out for your strong understanding of Metadata Management, Data Quality, Data Lineage and Data Management
• You are respected for your knowledge of Solution Development and Data Management Lifecycles
• You are recognized for your understanding of integration patterns including RESTful architecture and patterns, APIs and event based processing

• You are hands on in Windows Operating Systems, Unix, Linux, JSOn, Yaml, Swagger and with GCP Kubernetes (GKE), GCP Development and deployment using a CI/CD pipeline including Git, terraform, cloud build and deploy
• You are commended for your expertise with Collibra - including managing system activities, tenant administration, user groups creation etc
• You are recognized for your understanding of and experience with programming in JAVA especially Springboot or equivalent, with Collibra and Collibra APIs or GCP SDK experience
• You are recognized for your understanding of and experience with Oracle, SQL server, GCP BigQuery,PostgreSQL,and NoSQL
• You are an expert communicator and strategic thinker, able to provide a consultative approach in alignment with the Telco Management Industry Framework
• You are an excellent and effective presenter able to communicate ideas in a clear and concise manner
• You are an effective influencer and negotiator, able to be persuasive while upholding commitments to our customers, stakeholders and TELUS’ commitment to integrity
• Fluency in speaking, reading and writing in English
• 4+ years Data Engineering experience / 2 year data solution architecture and design
• University degree in computer science and/or 5 years of working experience in Information Management
• Demonstrable DAMA international BOK Framework knowledge and/or application
• Fluency in speaking, reading and writing in French

Purpose of Job
We are seeking a highly analytical and skilled Data Scientist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data analysis, statistical modelling, and machine learning. The Data Scientist will be responsible for designing, enhancing, and implementing data-driven solutions supporting the Bank's AML/ATF Client Risk Rating models.

Key Job Accountabilities
• Apply range of modeling techniques from basic statistical models to AI and Machine Learning, to develop, maintain and implement models for client risk rating case generation in support of Scotiabank’s AML/ATF program
• Creation and maintenance of documentation for models and for the results data analysis
• Collaborating and coordinating with teams from model validation, internal audit, and external audit to ensure that models meet all legal and regulatory requirements
• Communicate complex data findings and insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Support the communication with first and second lines of business and other stakeholders, and recommending changes to AML/ATF client risk rating models as appropriate
• Support the communication with model users to ensure that model limitations are properly understood, and that models meet model governance/usage requirements

• Experience with statistical modeling and data science methods

The Senior Analyst, Business Banking Credit Risk Analytics supports the execution of accurate and efficient reporting solutions for risk, regulatory and management information to internal and external stakeholders including regulatory bodies. She/he further supports an efficient and effective risk management function which uses common information sources and practices, reduces ongoing costs, increases service level performance, and minimizes risk.

The role has three primary areas of accountability which are described in more detail below. Across all these areas, he/she acts as a trusted advisor to Risk and the business, providing specialized consulting, analytical and technical support. This includes engaging key stakeholders on objectives and requirements, building effective analyses & tools to support decisions, and presenting findings in a simple, clear way to drive action. While this role focuses on Business Banking across North America, it may also work on broader enterprise-wide initiatives.
Develop Strategy and Portfolio level monitoring that yield insight

• Create presentations and self-service tools to allow Senior Executives, Product Partners and other stakeholders to clearly understand the performance of Credit Strategies and the Overall North American Business Banking portfolio.
• Conducts independent analysis and assessment to resolve strategic issues.
• Highlight insights that drive improvements in business profitability and performance, including identification of emerging issues and trends.
• Continuously improve consistency and transparency of risk measurement, metrics and reporting
• Develop a strong understanding of Business Banking Data Architecture and how data flows between systems.
• Determine the optimal sources of data for timely and effective monitoring. Surface opportunities to further improve the accuracy and timeliness of reports.
• Assemble presentations that are intuitive, easily digestible and action oriented.
• Support strong governance of reporting processes. Participate in any migration projects that will impact the availability and meaning of Business Banking data.
• Support the maintenance of operational procedures and processes related to analytical and reporting processes.
• Participate in regular forecasting discussions, particularly around PCL (Provision for Credit Losses).
• Maintain strong relationships with Collections units to foresee performance trends that may impact forecasts.
• Undertake stress testing or other performance analyses to understand the range of potential financial outcomes.
Oversee development of Risk and Capital Models
• Establish effective working relationships with Canadian and US modeling teams
• Support Business Banking Credit leaders in overseeing model performance and understanding shifts in their performance. Petition for new models as performance deteriorates.

• Collaborate on the development of new models by providing business insights into the selection and use of variables. Ensure datasets used for model development are robust, and that new model implementation is thoroughly tested and reliable.
• Typically, 1-3 years of relevant experience and post-secondary degree in related field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Knowledge of reporting & analytics concepts and applications
• Industry trends and regulatory requirements for risk reporting
• Strong financial, quantitative, and analytic skills to make data driven decisions
• In depth expertise with key technologies including SAS, SQL, Power BI, Python, Microsoft Products
• Proven ability to apply expertise and creativity to solve complex problems and manage ambiguity
• Strong time management and project management skills

Borealis AI is looking for a Senior Research Team Lead. The role includes managing a team of research team leads, researchers, and research engineers with the goal of delivering AI-based products for the financial services industry. In addition, you will lead initiatives that improve the effectiveness of the research organization.
• To lead a team of machine learning researchers delivering cutting edge AI technology to support AI-based products.
• To partner with Borealis AI’s product and engineering teams to ensure the seamless delivery of these products.
• To manage other research team leads and provide guidance and support.
• To lead initiatives that improve the overall performance of the Borealis AI Research Team.
• To help recruit, mentor and retain a high-performing research team.
You’re our ideal candidate if you have:
<li>A Ph.D. degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
<li>5 years of experience leading machine learning research teams in a product-centric environment or equivalent experience
<li>A track record of successful people management including mentoring junior researchers and engineers, experienced high-performance researchers, and research managers
<li>Involvement across the research and development lifecycle, from prototyping to production, engaging with stakeholders to develop solutions that meet business needs
<li>Detailed knowledge of cutting edge machine learning techniques
<li>The ability to formulate and drive a research project independently

<li>Become part of a team that thinks progressively and works collaboratively. We care about seeing each other reach full potential
<li>A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable

Borealis AI, a RBC Institute for Research, is a curiosity-driven research centre dedicated to achieving state-of-the-art in machine learning. Established in 2016, and with labs in Toronto, Montreal, Waterloo and Vancouver, we support academic collaborations and partner with world-class research centres in artificial intelligence. With a focus on ethical AI that will help communities thrive, our machine learning scientists perform fundamental and applied research in areas such as reinforcement learning, natural language processing, deep learning, and unsupervised learning to solve ground-breaking problems in diverse fields.

The Senior Manager, Payment Analytics will be a leading contributor in the Analytics & Decision Science team supporting Personal and Business Banking. The Analytics & Decision Science team focuses on creating next generation analytics assets to enable data-driven decision making for partners in Product, Marketing, Client Segment and Strategy. In this role, you will lead analytics engagements to evaluate client behaviors and optimize business decisions related to product, payments and other business areas. You will present insights and make data-driven recommendations to senior leaders to help identify opportunities to grow the business and better serve our clients.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

Analytics – Independently identify and leverage the right statistical techniques (descriptive, predictive, prescriptive) to extract actionable insights out of client behaviors and business trends (both internal and external). Appropriately integrate of big data, business intelligence, visualization, self-service and analytical tools into engagements. Proactively explore new applications of advanced analytics to innovate and build strategic analytics assets.
Technology – Leverage right data/analytical tools to analyze structured and unstructured datasets, build data pipeline and visualization from multiple data sources.

Communication – Find the story in data and be flexible in communicating at varying levels of details for the right audience.

You have a degree in a quantitative field (i.e. mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics, engineering, physics, business) or equivalent experience. Advanced degree is an asset (i.e. MMA, MBAN, MSc, MA, MBA).
You are proficient in programming languages and have experience using modern data, analytical and dashboard tools (i.e. SAS, SQL, Python, R, , Alteryx, Tableau, Cognos).

You have experience in building end-to-end analytics solutions involving large datasets (i.e. requirement gathering, data extraction, cleaning and transformation, statistical analysis, presentation & implementation).

You are a problem solver. You have exceptional critical thinking, problem solving and decision making skills with demonstrated ability to independently identify and analyze business problems and recommend solutions.
You have working knowledge of statistical techniques (i.e. Regression, Time-series analysis, Clustering, Decision trees, RFM, Demand forecasting).

You are an avid learner who recognizes the analytics field is constantly evolving. You seek to explore emerging trends and best practices in the industry and are excited to share the knowledge with others.

You can be clearly understood. You have very strong communication and presentation skills with a demonstrated ability to clearly and concisely present information to groups and individuals at all levels in the organization.
You put our clients first. You engage with purpose to find the right solutions. You go the extra mile, because it\'s the right thing to do.

Our Values
At TD we’re guided by our purpose is to enrich the lives of our customers, communities and colleagues, and share a set of values that shape our culture and guide our behavior. In exchange for how our colleagues show up to help TD succeed, we are committed to delivering a colleague experience grounded in Impact, Growth and a Culture of Care. No matter where you work across TD, we empower you to make an impact at work and in your community, explore and grow your career and be part of our caring and inclusive culture.

Making Your Well-being a Priority
A caring and supportive culture that promotes colleague well-being is core to who we are. At TD, we focus on total well-being with extensive programs to help colleagues assess, manage, and improve their well-being across four core pillars — physical, financial, social and mental/emotional. In addition, we champion a safe, inclusive and supportive work environment to help colleagues feel a sense of belonging, and supported in their personal and professional growth. Through our focus on total well-being, we know that we can help our colleagues thrive, contribute to our culture of care, and support better business outcomes … because when colleagues feel their best, they’re more likely to do their best.

Our Total Rewards Package
Our Total Rewards package reflects the investment we make in our colleagues to help them, and their families achieve their well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits including medical, dental, vision & mental health coverage, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs.

How We Work
At TD, we believe in-person connections fuel collaboration and collective creativity. Our workplace experience empowers colleagues to do great work side-by-side at TD locations, while offering flexibility to work remotely where it makes sense for the work and team. Our teams work in one of three workplace models: hybrid, onsite and primarily remote. Wherever our colleagues are working, they’ll always have access to the TD community and experience our culture of care.

Who We Are
TD is one of the world’s leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches. Every day, we deliver legendary customer experiences to over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to the Bank, those we serve, and the economies we support. We are guided by our vision to Be the Better Bank and our purpose to enrich the lives of our customers, communities and colleagues. TD is a customer obsessed organization, and we are deeply committed to being a leader in customer experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are customer facing. As we build our business and deliver on our strategy, we are innovating to enhance the customer experience and build capabilities to shape the future of banking. Whether you’ve got years of banking experience or are just starting your career in financial services, we can help you realize your potential. Through regular leadership and development conversations to mentorship and training programs, we’re here to support you towards your goals. As an organization, we keep growing – and so will you.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
At TD, we’re committed to fostering an environment where all colleagues are encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work, experience equitable opportunities, and feel respected and supported. We’re dedicated to building an inclusive workforce that reflects the diversity of the customers and the communities in which we live and serve.

How We’re Helping Make an Impact in Communities
TD has a long-standing commitment to help drive progress towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. That’s why we launched the TD Ready Commitment in 2018, now a multi-year North American initiative. Under the TD Ready Commitment, we are targeting a total of $1 billion by 2030 in community giving four key, interconnected drivers of change: Financial Security, Vibrant Planet, Connected Communities, and Better Health. It’s our goal to help support change, nurture progress, and contribute to making the world a better, more inclusive place for our customers, colleagues, and communities.

Accommodation
Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.
We look forward to hearing from you!

The Risk Analytics team is deeply integrated within OMERS and operates on a foundational principle of trusted partner aligned to and supporting the overall objectives of OMERS. We provide both an independent view of risk-taking activities, as well as analytics and research to inform portfolio construction and risk optimization. The team is responsible for supporting a consolidated view of the total plan risk appetite and investment risk across all OMERS investment platforms.

As an Analyst on the Risk Analytics team, you will be responsible for research, development, and evaluation of quantitative risk metrics employed at the Total Plan level. This will require a combination of knowledge of statistical modeling, macroeconomic trends, and the ability to translate large amounts of quantitative and qualitative information into insights that support effective risk management.
As a member of this team, you will be responsible for:
• Supporting the development of initiatives related to Total Plan Risk such as asset/liability management, risk appetite, and climate risk
• Computing inputs for the quarterly investment risk report delivered to senior executives and the Board. This includes connecting with people across the organization to compile the required data
• Introducing enhancements to existing risk measures and approaches to monitor investment risks across business units, asset classes, industries, and regions
• Contributing to the ongoing development of a leading risk analytics program to support OMERS investment activities and the evolution of its investment strategies with a collaborative mindset
• Working with investment data to help ramp up the development of insightful tools that support the measurement and reporting of investment risk

• Researching emerging risks, trends, and best practices in risk management. This includes following macroeconomic themes, market trends and new research papers to identify opportunities to add insights to the OMERS portfolio
• Supporting the team’s technology and automation initiatives and liaising with the Analytics Oversight team to help enhance our data pipelines, risk tools, and dashboard development
• Interacting and building relationships with investment professionals across Risk and the investment teams to understand and communicate the needs of the business

column1: The Data Governance Developer will work as part of the Enterprise Data Governance Team to plan and lead the rollout of data governance tool capabilities while focusing on the adoption and process implementation for critical governance aspect related to data quality and metadata management.

This role will operate within Data & Technology to provide technical guidance related to Collibra, Informatica, MS Purview and related application and reporting integrations. They collaborate with the data stewards and technical custodians through data governance projects and initiatives across the organization. This position offers an opportunity to influence and guide data governance adoption across various lines of business at OMERS (Pensions, Investments, Oxford and Corporate) to drive business success and ensure data integrity.

• Design, develop and monitor technology capabilities for key data governance focus areas of data catalog, metadata management, data quality management, data lineage, workflows, and access management.
• Provide ongoing access, maintenance, usage, and technical support for our Data Governance Tool inventory including Collibra, Informatica and Purview
• Responsible for being the primary point of contact for business partners to resolve data governance tool related technical issues on Collibra, Information and Purview.
• Manage the processes around metadata repositories (data dictionary, business glossary) and data classification process (identification of sensitive data)

• Transform business requirements to define data quality management approach for the business partner along with creating the necessary system and platforms integrations to implement data quality rules and build data quality monitoring.

• Implement data quality processes including data profiling, data quality analysis, parsing, standardization, enrichment, deploy mappings that will run in a scheduled, batch, or real-time environment and the development of data quality rules to support monitoring (using Informatica Cloud Data Quality (CDQ)) and remediation activities.
• Work closely with Data & Technology team during the development of new data governance capabilities and related integration with other applications, including requirements validation and testing.

• Create and maintain technical documentation in all aspects of Data Governance work including (not limited to) related to data quality processes, metadata management, data mappings, and data governance processes etc.
• Create and maintain appropriate materials for education, onboarding, and training for new and existing employees to educate and drive data governance best practices.

Expert level skills in Collibra and/or Informatica IICS/CDQ platform as a whole and the integration among different components and services to carry out technical deployment and integration and troubleshoot user issues.
3+ years of experience working with vendors such as Collibra and Informatica vendors to discuss new functionality rollout or technical issue resolution related work.
Experience with SQL, database applications MS SQL/ Oracle, and visualization tools such as Power BI is necessary.
Strong understanding of data modeling concepts and data warehouse design (star schema, snowflake schema, etc.) is required.
Strong functional understanding of performance tuning methods, mapplets, worklets, stored procedures & data mappings Relevant certifications in Informatica or data governance are a plus.
Excellent knowledge of data management, analytics platforms, ETL, data architecture and integration areas of work.
Knowledge and expertise in data governance technology, business process modeling, data classification, data quality and enterprise implementation of data governance tools and solutions.
• Excellent verbal and written communication to effectively articulate and communicate with both business and technical development teams.

We believe that time together in the office is important for OMERS and Oxford, the strength of our employees, and the work we do for our pension members. In delivering on our pension promise, keeping us connected to our work and each other, our flexible hybrid work guideline requires teams to come in to the office 3 days per week.

Founded in 1962, OMERS is one of Canada’s largest defined benefit pension plans, with $128.6 CAD billion in net assets as of December 31, 2023. OMERS is a jointly-sponsored pension plan, with more than 1,000 participating employers ranging from large cities to local agencies, and over half a million active, deferred and retired members. OMERS members include union and non-union employees of municipalities, school boards, local boards, transit systems, electrical utilities, emergency services and children’s aid societies across Ontario. Contributions to the Plan are funded equally by members and employers. OMERS teams work in Toronto, London, New York, Amsterdam, Luxembourg, Singapore, Sydney and other major cities across North America and Europe – serving members and employers and originating and managing a diversified portfolio of high-quality investments in public markets, private equity, infrastructure and real estate.

OMERS is committed to having a workforce that reflects the communities in which we live and work. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to a barrier-free recruitment and selection process.
